notes: YOLO11s baseline: COCO-pretrained yolo11s at imgsz 1824 with Ultralytics default training hyperparameters
Faster R-CNN baseline: COCO-pretrained ResNet50-FPN v2, SGD at a constant LR without warmup or augmentation, frozen BatchNorm, torchvision default RPN and RoI heads
RetinaNet baseline: COCO-pretrained ResNet50-FPN v2, SGD at a constant LR without warmup or augmentation, frozen BatchNorm, torchvision default anchors and matching

RT-DETRv2 baseline: COCO-pretrained R50vd, AdamW per the RT-DETRv2 recipe with linear warmup then a constant LR, no EMA, no augmentation, frozen BatchNorm, checkpoint default queries, denoising, matcher, and losses
Tests a cosine LR decay from the baseline LR 0.005 to 0 over the baseline's 10 epochs without warmup, against the decline after the baseline's best epoch 2 at a constant LR
Tests RPN anchors one octave smaller (16 to 256 px over P2 to P6 instead of 32 to 512) for the small objects, still 3 per location so the COCO RPN head loads
Tests the GIoU loss instead of Smooth L1 for the second-stage box regression, with the baseline giou_loss_weight 10, for better localization at the higher IoU thresholds of mAP@[.5:.95]
Seed repeat of the baseline for 5 epochs (seed 7 instead of 42): its difference from the baseline over epochs 1 to 5 is the seed noise estimate for lr_cosine, anchors_small, and giou_loss

Tests input size 1280 instead of 1824 for training and inference: the speed versus accuracy point, with train objects (step 5) at a median sqrt(area) of 30 px instead of 43 px in the network input, 55% instead of 28% below 32 px and 10% instead of 2% below 16 px

Tests TAL topk 20 instead of 10: more positive grid points for medium and large objects, where the baseline trails Faster R-CNN (AP_medium 0.248 vs 0.274, AP_large 0.396 vs 0.464), while most small objects already use all of their candidates

Tests both AdamW learning rates scaled by the effective batch size (4 instead of the recipe's 16), against the baseline's decline after its best epoch 2: monitoring mAP fell from 0.323 to 0.296 over epochs 3 to 7 at the constant LR 1e-4 while the training loss kept falling

Tests 200 denoising queries instead of 100, so that dense frames train with several denoising groups: the number of groups is num_denoising // (most GT boxes of a frame in the batch), and at 100 59% of training batches (step 5, batch 2) have a single group

Tests anchors one octave smaller (base sizes 16 to 256 px over P3 to P7, 3 scales per octave) for the small objects of the data analysis (median sqrt(area) 45.7 px, 24.8% below 32 px, 5th percentile 19.8 px); still 9 per location so the COCO heads load
Tests focal loss gamma 1 instead of 2 (alpha stays 0.25): less weight on hard examples, which include unlabelled objects in ignored regions that train as negatives on unmodified frames
Tests scale augmentation gain 0.25 instead of 0.5: random resize factors in [0.75, 1.25] instead of [0.5, 1.5], so that small objects are not shrunk below what stride 8 resolves
Seed repeat of lr_scaled (seed 7 instead of 42): its gain over the baseline (+0.0096 mAP) comes almost entirely from bus and truck, so this run tells whether that gain survives another seed

Tests train frames at step 2 instead of 5 at the same GPU budget: 2.5 times more distinct frames per epoch, against the baseline's early peak (epoch 2) and decline while the training losses keep falling, which suggests overfitting to the step-5 frames of 56 clips
Post-processing baseline: the saved predictions of the reference model rtdetr-baseline, unchanged (no fusion, no temporal rescoring), so that it reproduces the reference row

M2 plus I6: the three-family WBF of ens_rtdetr_frcnn_yolo followed by temporal rescoring along tracks, to test whether the gain of rescoring on single models (+0.0067 mAP on rtdetr-baseline, +0.0045 on rtdetr-lr_scaled_repeat-s7, +0.0068 on faster_rcnn-giou_loss, +0.0053 on yolo-baseline) adds to the fusion; weight and link IoU chosen on the fused val predictions (laptop grid of link IoU 0.3 / 0.5, weight 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75, mean or max: max at weight 0.5 best, link IoU 0.3 and 0.5 within 0.0001 mAP)

M2 with three families: WBF of rtdetr-baseline, faster_rcnn-giou_loss, and yolo-baseline, the three detectors with different assignment schemes and the best small-object recall among the CNNs for YOLO (04_anchor_free.ipynb section 7); equal weights and IoU 0.65 were chosen on val predictions (laptop grid of four weightings and IoU 0.55 to 0.65: equal weights best at every IoU)

M2 with every completed RT-DETR run: WBF of the four RT-DETR runs (baseline, lr_scaled, lr_scaled_repeat-s7, denoising_groups; seeds 42 and 7), faster_rcnn-giou_loss, and yolo-baseline, to test whether more RT-DETR members add to the three-family fusion; weights 0.5 per RT-DETR run (2 for the family against 1 each for the CNNs) and IoU 0.7 chosen on val predictions (laptop grid of 6 settings: equal weights 0.3588 to 0.3593 mAP, half weights 0.3641 at IoU 0.65 and 0.3645 at 0.7; the four RT-DETR runs alone 0.3297)

M2 with two families: WBF of rtdetr-baseline and the tuned Faster R-CNN faster_rcnn-giou_loss, which has the best AP50 and different errors (02_two_stage.ipynb section 7, 05_query_based.ipynb section 8); equal weights and IoU 0.65 were chosen on val predictions (laptop grid of weights 1:1, 2:1, 3:1 and IoU 0.5 to 0.7: equal weights best at every IoU, 0.6 to 0.7 within 0.0002 mAP; WBF above NMS fusion by 0.016 mAP at equal weights)

I6 temporal rescoring on rtdetr-baseline: every detection's score moves halfway toward the highest score along its same-class track over consecutive frames, so objects confirmed in neighbouring frames outrank single-frame detections; chosen on val predictions (laptop grid of link IoU 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7, weight 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75, mean or max, min score 0 / 0.05: max above mean at every setting, weight 0.5 best, link IoU 0.3 and 0.5 within 0.0002 mAP)

Inference only, on rtdetr-baseline: keeps the 500 top-scoring (query, class) pairs per frame instead of 300, the submission limit that the other families already use; every val frame hits the 300 cap, so lower-ranked pairs may add recall at the tail of the precision-recall curve

Inference only, on rtdetr-baseline: predicts horizontally flipped frames and mirrors the boxes back; alone it measures how far the model is from flip-invariant, and it is the second member of the flip TTA fusion postprocess-ens_rtdetr_hflip

I2 horizontal-flip TTA on rtdetr-baseline: fuses its predictions on the original and on the flipped frames (rtdetr-infer_hflip) with WBF at the reference defaults (equal weights, IoU 0.55), so that boxes found in both views gain score and averaged corners; untuned, since the flipped predictions do not exist before this queue

Inference only, on rtdetr-baseline: frames resized to a shorter side of 1280 px instead of the training size 1024 px (25% larger), for the small objects that limit mAP (AP_small 0.133 against AP_large 0.486); the model then sees every object larger than in training, which may cost AP_large

Inference only, on rtdetr-baseline: frames resized to a shorter side of 1152 px instead of the training size 1024 px (13% larger), for the small objects that limit mAP (AP_small 0.133 against AP_large 0.486); the model then sees every object larger than in training, which may cost AP_large

Inference only, on rtdetr-baseline: frames resized to a shorter side of 1408 px instead of the training size 1024 px (38% larger), for the small objects that limit mAP (AP_small 0.133 against AP_large 0.486); the model then sees every object larger than in training, which may cost AP_large

Tests the RT-DETRv2 recipe augmentation (horizontal flip, photometric distortion, multi-scale training, all off in the last epoch) instead of unmodified frames, against the baseline's peak at epoch 2 of 7 and its decline while the training losses keep falling, which suggests overfitting to the 56 training clips

Tests filling the ignored regions of the training frames with the train mean colour, except labelled boxes, instead of training them as background: unlabelled crowds and dense parking in 72 to 75% of frames (01_eda.ipynb section 7) currently teach queries that objects there are background, while the evaluator ignores detections inside them

Ablation of augment_recipe without multi-scale training: horizontal flip and photometric distortion only (off in the last epoch), to separate the effect of the image-level augmentation from that of the varying input size

Box smoothing on top of temporal_rtdetr: every box linked in both neighbouring frames becomes (previous + 2 * current + next) / 4 after the rescoring, against frame-to-frame jitter of the boxes; on val predictions +0.0025 mAP (+0.0041 AP75), both val folds +0.002, while filling one-frame gaps in tracks added only +0.0005 and was dropped (laptop grid)

Box smoothing on top of ens_rtdetr_frcnn_yolo_temporal, to test whether its gain on rtdetr-baseline (temporal_smooth_rtdetr) adds to the three-family fusion; on val predictions +0.0032 mAP (laptop grid)

ens_rtdetr_frcnn_yolo_temporal_smooth with rtdetr-augment_recipe (+0.0164 mAP over rtdetr-baseline) as the RT-DETR member, to test whether the better single model carries into the fusion; on val predictions 0.3724 mAP against 0.3649, both val folds higher; weights 2 / 1 / 1 gave +0.0015 with the folds moving in opposite directions, so equal weights stay (laptop grid)

ens_recipe_frcnn_yolo_smooth plus yolo-imgsz_1280 as a fourth member, a YOLO trained at a second input scale, the extra member that added most to the three-family WBF (+0.0063 mAP, against +0.0023 to +0.0042 for retinanet-baseline, faster_rcnn-lr_cosine, and yolo-tal_topk); on val predictions 0.3755 mAP against 0.3724, both val folds higher (laptop grid)

Inference only, on yolo-baseline: imgsz 1280 instead of the training size 1824, as an ensemble member at a second scale; yolo-imgsz_1280, trained at 1280, added +0.0063 mAP to the WBF of rtdetr-baseline, faster_rcnn-giou_loss, and yolo-baseline, and this run tells whether the scale alone gives that gain

Inference only, on yolo-baseline, which trained with Ultralytics' default horizontal flips (fliplr 0.5): predicts flipped frames and mirrors the boxes back, the flip member of a flip TTA fusion; rtdetr-baseline, trained without flips, predicts about 2.2 input px to the right on flipped frames

Inference only, on rtdetr-augment_recipe, which trained with horizontal flips: predicts flipped frames and mirrors the boxes back, the flip member of a flip TTA fusion; rtdetr-baseline, trained without flips, predicts about 2.2 input px to the right on flipped frames (mAP 0.3049 against 0.3209), so this run tells whether flip training removes that offset

Inference only, on rtdetr-augment_recipe, which trained at shorter sides of 832 to 1216 px: frames resized to 1152 px instead of 1024 px, the best inference size for rtdetr-baseline (infer_size1152, +0.0045 mAP, AP_small 0.1475 against 0.1334)

Final RT-DETR (M1): the two data settings that raised val mAP, combined: the augmentation recipe of augment_recipe (+0.0164 mAP, above the 0.0094 seed noise) on train frames at step 2 (step2, +0.0069), the step AGENTS.md sets for final models; lr_scaled is left out because its gain did not repeat with seed 7
Inference only, on rtdetr-recipe_step2, the final RT-DETR: keeps the 500 top-scoring (query, class) pairs per frame instead of 300, the change of infer_det500 (+0.0021 mAP on rtdetr-baseline)

Inference only, on rtdetr-recipe_step2, the final RT-DETR, which trained at shorter sides of 832 to 1216 px: frames resized to 1152 px instead of 1024 px, the change of infer_size1152 (+0.0045 mAP on rtdetr-baseline)

Tests an exponential moving average of the weights (official RT-DETRv2 ModelEMA, [ema] in the baseline) instead of the trained weights, against the baseline's epoch-to-epoch swings of 0.005 to 0.01 monitoring mAP and its decline after epoch 2 (0.3227 to 0.2960)

Seed repeat of recipe_step2 (seed 7 instead of 42): the final model's gain over the baseline counts as established only if it holds with another seed, since RT-DETR seeds differ by 0.0094 mAP (lr_scaled against lr_scaled_repeat-s7)

ens_recipe_frcnn_yolo_yolo1280_smooth plus three RT-DETR members (the flip member rtdetr-infer_recipe_hflip, rtdetr-infer_recipe_step2_det500, and the seed 7 repeat rtdetr-recipe_step2_repeat-s7) and a second Faster R-CNN (faster_rcnn-lr_cosine), chosen by forward selection on val predictions: 0.3859 mAP against 0.3755, both val folds higher (laptop grid); further members, weights, WBF IoU, and temporal settings changed it by at most 0.0006

Inference only, on rtdetr-recipe_step2, the final RT-DETR: every frame shrunk 2x before detection, a val stand-in for the 680x382 and 960x540 test frames, the reference of recipe_step2_low_res on half-resolution frames; its predictions.csv holds shrunk test frames and is not a submission

M1 (recipe_step2) plus low-resolution augmentation: a quarter of the augmented training frames is shrunk 2x before the detector resizes it, for the 600 test frames (16%) at 680x382 and 960x540, a resolution train and val lack; chosen from test frame sizes, a deviation from AGENTS.md data rule 4 decided by the user on 2026-11-09 (docs/pipeline.md §12.4); kept if val mAP stays within the 0.0094 seed noise of recipe_step2 (0.3402) and half-resolution val mAP (infer_recipe_step2_low_res_half against infer_recipe_step2_half) rises by more than 0.0094

Inference only, on rtdetr-recipe_step2_low_res: every frame shrunk 2x before detection, the half-resolution val check of the low-resolution augmentation against infer_recipe_step2_half; its predictions.csv holds shrunk test frames and is not a submission

Inference only, on rtdetr-recipe_step2_low_res: keeps the 500 top-scoring (query, class) pairs per frame instead of 300, as infer_recipe_step2_det500 (+0.0015 mAP on rtdetr-recipe_step2), the ensemble member that would replace infer_recipe_step2_det500

Trained on train and val, val not held out, so its val metrics are not comparable with other runs: M1 (recipe_step2) for its best epoch 1 of 3 on the 63 clips instead of 56, the same augmented first epoch at step 2 with 10% more frames; checked on the public LB against rtdetr-infer_recipe_step2_det500 (0.2722) through infer_trainval_recipe_step2_det500

Inference only, on rtdetr-trainval_recipe_step2: keeps the 500 top-scoring (query, class) pairs per frame, as infer_recipe_step2_det500, so that the public LB compares the two on training data alone (0.2722 for train only)

Trained on train and val, val not held out: augment_recipe for its best epoch 2 of 7 on the 63 clips, step 5 frames twice instead of step 2 frames once (trainval_recipe_step2); on val the two schedules are within seed noise (augment_recipe 0.3373, recipe_step2 0.3402), and this is the train and val counterpart of the ensemble member rtdetr-augment_recipe

Inference only, on rtdetr-trainval_recipe_step5, which trained with horizontal flips: predicts flipped frames and mirrors the boxes back, the train and val counterpart of the flip member rtdetr-infer_recipe_hflip

Trained on train and val, val not held out: trainval_recipe_step2 with seed 7, the train and val counterpart of the ensemble member rtdetr-recipe_step2_repeat-s7 (best epoch 1 of 3, monitoring 0.3417)
Trained on train and val, val not held out: giou_loss for its best epoch 2 of 5 on the 63 clips, the train and val counterpart of the ensemble member faster_rcnn-giou_loss

Trained on train and val, val not held out: the baseline for 2 epochs on the 63 clips, standing in for the ensemble member faster_rcnn-lr_cosine, whose best epoch 2 of 10 trained at a cosine LR still 0.90 to 1.0 times the constant baseline LR; the baseline itself also peaked at epoch 2 (0.3024)

ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth with every RT-DETR and Faster R-CNN member replaced by its counterpart trained on train and val (same recipe, best epoch of the val run, 63 clips); the YOLO members stay train only; val is not held out for six of the eight members, so its val mAP is not comparable, and the public LB is the only check (0.2981 for ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth)

Cross-validation fold 0 of the final RT-DETR recipe (trainval_recipe_step2 with 500 detections, as the ensemble member infer_recipe_step2_det500): trained on folds other than 0 (42 clips), validated on fold_0 (21 clips), to estimate its mAP over all 63 clips instead of 7
Cross-validation fold 0 of the Faster R-CNN ensemble member giou_loss for its best epoch 2 (as trainval_giou_loss): trained on folds other than 0 (42 clips), validated on fold_0 (21 clips)

Cross-validation fold 0 of a two-family ensemble: WBF of rtdetr-cv_recipe_step2_fold0 and faster_rcnn-cv_giou_loss_fold0 with the fusion and temporal settings of ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth, to check on 21 clips per fold whether fusing the two families beats the RT-DETR member alone

Cross-validation fold 1 of the final RT-DETR recipe (trainval_recipe_step2 with 500 detections, as the ensemble member infer_recipe_step2_det500): trained on folds other than 1 (42 clips), validated on fold_1 (21 clips), to estimate its mAP over all 63 clips instead of 7
Cross-validation fold 1 of the Faster R-CNN ensemble member giou_loss for its best epoch 2 (as trainval_giou_loss): trained on folds other than 1 (42 clips), validated on fold_1 (21 clips)

Cross-validation fold 1 of a two-family ensemble: WBF of rtdetr-cv_recipe_step2_fold1 and faster_rcnn-cv_giou_loss_fold1 with the fusion and temporal settings of ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth, to check on 21 clips per fold whether fusing the two families beats the RT-DETR member alone

Cross-validation fold 2 of the final RT-DETR recipe (trainval_recipe_step2 with 500 detections, as the ensemble member infer_recipe_step2_det500): trained on folds other than 2 (42 clips), validated on fold_2 (21 clips), to estimate its mAP over all 63 clips instead of 7
Cross-validation fold 2 of the Faster R-CNN ensemble member giou_loss for its best epoch 2 (as trainval_giou_loss): trained on folds other than 2 (42 clips), validated on fold_2 (21 clips)

Cross-validation fold 2 of a two-family ensemble: WBF of rtdetr-cv_recipe_step2_fold2 and faster_rcnn-cv_giou_loss_fold2 with the fusion and temporal settings of ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth, to check on 21 clips per fold whether fusing the two families beats the RT-DETR member alone

Tests the RT-DETRv2 recipe augmentation of rtdetr-augment_recipe (horizontal flip, photometric distortion, multi-scale training, clean last epoch; +0.0164 mAP on RT-DETR, the only data change above the 0.0094 seed noise) on the Faster R-CNN ensemble member giou_loss, whose frames are unmodified; keep if val mAP beats giou_loss (0.3066) by more than 0.0094 and swapping it into ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth raises both val folds

recipe_step2 at effective batch 16, the official RT-DETRv2 batch for which the recipe LR (1e-4, backbone 1e-5) was set, instead of 4, which the 12 GB of the PC forced; for a large cloud GPU (Colab G4); warmup kept at 8,000 frames and more epochs, because one epoch has 4 times fewer optimizer steps

yolo26m_p2_tiles at batch 16 instead of 3, for a large cloud GPU (Colab G4): the effective batch stays 64 (Ultralytics nbs, 4 accumulated batches instead of 21), so the optimizer steps, LR, and warmup are unchanged, and BatchNorm statistics come from 16 tiles instead of 3
Inference only, on yolo-yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16: imgsz 2304 instead of the 1920 it was tiled for, objects 1.2 times larger, as the second scale of a multi-scale fusion

Inference only, on yolo-yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16, which trained with Ultralytics' default horizontal flips (fliplr 0.5): predicts flipped frames and mirrors the boxes back, the flip member of a flip TTA fusion and a further fusion member

Inference only, on yolo-yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16: NMS IoU 0.65 instead of 0.5, so that overlapping objects of one class (riders on bicycles and motors, dense crowds; 3.4% of train objects overlap another at IoU above 0.5) suppress each other less

ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo2_smooth (D) plus yolo-yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16 as a ninth member, chosen by forward selection on val predictions: 0.3887 mAP against 0.3859, both val folds higher (0.3896 and 0.3272 against 0.3882 and 0.3215, laptop grid); weight 2 for it gave 0.3888, adding rtdetr-recipe_step2_b16 as well gave 0.3879, and replacing the two YOLO11 members with it gave 0.3829

Test-time augmentation of yolo-yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16: WBF of its predictions at imgsz 1920, at 2304, and on flipped frames, at the WBF reference defaults (equal weights, IoU 0.55); untuned, since the members do not exist before this queue

ens_rtdetr4_frcnn2_yolo3_smooth (E) plus yolo-infer_yolo26m_p2_tiles_b16_size2304 as a tenth member, chosen by forward selection on val predictions: 0.3905 mAP against 0.3887, both val folds higher (0.3911 and 0.3291 against 0.3896 and 0.3272, laptop grid); adding the flip member instead gave 0.3901, both 0.3903, the WBF of the YOLO26m TTA as a member 0.3903, or in place of the b16 member 0.3904, and the NMS IoU 0.65 member in place of b16 0.3884
